import os
import math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

def generate_frames():
    output_dir = r"C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\stickman_excited"
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    width, height = 1920, 1080

    for frame in range(60):
        # Background
        img = Image.new('RGB', (width, height), color=(240, 230, 210))
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

        # Draw blackboard
        board_rect = [100, 150, 1500, 900]
        # Frame
        draw.rectangle([80, 130, 1520, 920], fill=(120, 80, 40))
        # Board
        draw.rectangle(board_rect, fill=(30, 60, 40))
        
        # Blackboard drawings (math / charts)
        draw.line([200, 300, 400, 300], fill="white", width=8)
        draw.line([250, 350, 350, 350], fill="white", width=8)
        draw.ellipse([500, 250, 700, 450], outline="white", width=8)
        draw.line([500, 350, 700, 350], fill="white", width=8)
        draw.line([600, 250, 600, 450], fill="white", width=8)
        draw.rectangle([800, 300, 1100, 500], outline="white", width=8)
        draw.line([800, 500, 1100, 300], fill="white", width=8)
        
        # Draw stickman
        # Position stickman on the right side of the blackboard
        center_x, center_y = 1500, 650
        
        # Head
        head_radius = 90
        head_bbox = [center_x - head_radius, center_y - head_radius - 220, 
                     center_x + head_radius, center_y + head_radius - 220]
        draw.ellipse(head_bbox, fill=(255, 220, 180), outline="black", width=10)
        
        # Excited face
        # Wide Eyes
        draw.ellipse([center_x - 40, center_y - 250, center_x - 10, center_y - 210], fill="black")
        draw.ellipse([center_x + 10, center_y - 250, center_x + 40, center_y - 210], fill="black")
        # Highlights in eyes
        draw.ellipse([center_x - 25, center_y - 240, center_x - 15, center_y - 230], fill="white")
        draw.ellipse([center_x + 25, center_y - 240, center_x + 35, center_y - 230], fill="white")
        
        # Mouth (wide open smile)
        draw.chord([center_x - 50, center_y - 210, center_x + 50, center_y - 150], 
                   start=0, end=180, fill="black")
        # Tongue
        draw.chord([center_x - 30, center_y - 180, center_x + 30, center_y - 150], 
                   start=0, end=180, fill="red")
        
        # Body
        body_top = center_y - 130
        body_bottom = center_y + 150
        draw.line([center_x, body_top, center_x, body_bottom], fill="black", width=12)
        
        # Legs
        draw.line([center_x, body_bottom, center_x - 80, body_bottom + 250], fill="black", width=12)
        draw.line([center_x, body_bottom, center_x + 80, body_bottom + 250], fill="black", width=12)
        
        # Arms (animated raised)
        # Calculate wave angle for animation
        wave_angle = math.sin(frame / 60.0 * 6 * math.pi) * 40 # degrees
        
        # Shoulders
        shoulder_y = body_top + 40
        
        # Left arm (raised)
        left_shoulder = (center_x, shoulder_y)
        left_elbow = (center_x - 120, shoulder_y - 80)
        
        # Right arm (raised)
        right_shoulder = (center_x, shoulder_y)
        right_elbow = (center_x + 120, shoulder_y - 80)
        
        # Calculate hand positions based on waving
        arm_length = 130
        left_angle = math.radians(-135 + wave_angle)
        left_hand = (left_elbow[0] + arm_length * math.cos(left_angle), 
                     left_elbow[1] + arm_length * math.sin(left_angle))
        
        right_angle = math.radians(-45 - wave_angle)
        right_hand = (right_elbow[0] + arm_length * math.cos(right_angle), 
                      right_elbow[1] + arm_length * math.sin(right_angle))
        
        # Draw arms
        draw.line([left_shoulder, left_elbow, left_hand], fill="black", width=12, joint="curve")
        draw.line([right_shoulder, right_elbow, right_hand], fill="black", width=12, joint="curve")
        
        # Teaching pointer in right hand
        draw.line([right_hand[0], right_hand[1], right_hand[0] - 150, right_hand[1] - 50], fill="brown", width=8)
        
        # Save frame
        img.save(os.path.join(output_dir, f"frame_{frame:04d}.png"))

    print(f"Successfully generated 60 frames in {output_dir}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    generate_frames()
